paper_title: Low-Energy Supernovae Severely Constrain Radiative Particle Decays
notes: Paper constrains ALP-photon coupling G_agamma using low-luminosity core-collapse supernovae (LESNe) with explosion energies ~0.1 B. The constraint is based on energy deposition from radiative ALP decays (a→2γ) in the progenitor star. For 1–500 MeV-mass ALPs, the paper excludes G_agamma in the 10^-10–10^-8 GeV^-1 range. The exclusion region is shown in Fig. 2 (red-shaded area). Data points extracted from abstract statement and Fig. 2: lower bound at ~1 MeV (10^6 eV) with G_agamma ~ 10^-10 GeV^-1, upper bound at ~500 MeV (5×10^8 eV) with G_agamma ~ 10^-8 GeV^-1. The constraint assumes progenitor radius R* = 5×10^13 cm and energy deposition limit E_mantle < 0.1 B.
